articles.title: PREVIEW: Blackhawks Open Road Trip Against Red Wings
Blackhawks at Red Wings projected lineups
Need to Know: Bruins at Blues
Kane receives warm ovation from Red Wings fans in return to Detroit

away.summary: The Blackhawks (4-9-0) are coming off a 4-1 loss to the Detroit Red Wings on Thursday and did not practice Friday. Spencer Knight is projected to start in net, with Arvid Soderblom listed as the backup. Andrew Mangiapane and Ethan Del Mastro are scratched, while Bowen Byram remains out with an upper-body injury.

home.summary: The Bruins (9-4-1) are coming off a 4-1 loss to the St. Louis Blues on Thursday and held an optional skate Friday. Jeremy Swayman is projected to start in net, with Michael DiPietro as backup. Connor Clifton returns to the lineup after being a healthy scratch for the past seven games, replacing Frederic Brunet on the third defensive pair. No players are listed as injured.
